title: Challenges in Applying Explainability Methods to Improve the Fairness of NLP Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature that applies explainability methods (e.g., SHAP, LIME, feature attribution, and attention scores) to detect classifier over-sensitivity or under-sensitivity towards identity terms in hate speech and abusive language detection models.
Reviewing studies that use explainability methods like SHAP and aggregated attention scores to classify and measure the effect of political orientation bias in news and hate speech classification.
Reviewing the use of perturbation analysis and counterfactual generation to detect model sensitivity and biases related to specific named entities in sentiment analysis and toxicity detection tasks.
